preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(A) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in A) and all(1 <= x <= n for row in A for x in row)
preconditions.description: Table A has n rows and m columns, with each element between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(B) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in B) and all(1 <= x <= n for row in B for x in row)
preconditions.description: Table B has n rows and m columns, with each element between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (0 <= k <= 5000 and all(1 <= c <= m for c in columns) and transform(A, columns) == B)
postconditions.description: If impossible, output -1. Otherwise, output a sequence of at most 5000 valid column indices such that applying stable sorts by these columns in order transforms A into B.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible == (transform(A, []) != B and not any(transform(A, cols) == B for cols in all_valid_sequences))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if and only if no sequence of stable column sorts can transform A into B.
